sources.evidence: official feature table names ESP32, ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C3 machines; ESP32-C5 is absent
official esp32s3 machine, flash image, GDB and supported hardware-crypto path
official C5 DevKitC-1 and exact GPIO13/14 USB/SDIO multiplexed functions
official SDK exposes a host build platform; it is not an RP2350 instruction or peripheral emulator
official Pico 2 uses RP2350A with external 4-MB flash, unlike selected RP2354B with stacked 2-MB flash
official exact-MCU LaunchPad with XDS110, UART and EnergyTrace; no product power/watchdog wiring

evidence_layers.proves: portable framing, safety, update and scheduling logic under deterministic faults and sanitizers
evidence_layers.does_not_prove: target instruction execution, boot ROM, peripheral registers, signal timing or physical fault paths

evidence_layers.proves: selected production SDK/compiler linkage, image/map generation, partition fit and reproducibility
evidence_layers.does_not_prove: target boot, peripheral behavior, transport PHY or rollback transitions

evidence_layers.proves: only the CPU/memory/peripherals implemented by the named vendor machine
evidence_layers.does_not_prove: omitted peripherals, board wiring, RF, analog, power, timing or enclosure behavior

evidence_layers.proves: named silicon/module behavior and exposed peripherals on the named board
evidence_layers.does_not_prove: Leshy2 routing, muxes, quiet state, shared rails, antennas or cross-board transports

evidence_layers.proves: integrated product wiring, real transports/peripherals, recovery, power, RF coexistence and rollback under injected faults
